Registration hashes the command line right after spawn (transport-process-registration.ts:187-198), while the orphan sweep deletes a row without reaping when a same-PID, same-startedAt child's command hash differs (transport-process-registration.ts:120-128). That the launcher really execs in place comes from the external package and is inferred from this change.

F4.evidence: managed-launcher-failure.ts:35 compares the quoted path text from Node's inspected error output to the literal nativeCommand. Node's inspect escapes a backslash as \\, so a path containing one never matches, launchCode stays unset and no launch failure is recorded. This needs a POSIX install path with a literal backslash, which is unrealistic.
